meta.title: Observability — the per-call log & telemetry
meta.subtitle: One span() helper in the shared runtime fans every call to three stores; two audiences read them (doc 10)

cards.title: The one rule
items: Every model call logs {model, prompt_version, input, output, latency, cost, success} — emitted from the shared runtime (obs.py), never from the three callers
One span() context manager writes a spans row, mirrors a Langfuse generation, and increments Prometheus counters
Span kinds: model · tool · retrieval · guardrail · judge · skill; finalize() rolls spans into one runs row

cards.title: Three stores, three jobs
items: Postgres (runs/spans): source of truth for money + tenancy; partitioned by month; cost from our profiles (02/07)
Langfuse: full prompt/response I/O + nested traces, PII-redacted; the source of truth for 'what was said'
Prometheus: numeric time-series labeled workspace/agent/source/model for SLOs + autoscaling

cards.title: Two audiences (don't conflate)
items: Ops alerts → Alertmanager/on-call: first-token p95<2s, e2e p99≤30s, provider errors, deadline-cut rate
Owner notifications → in-product (doc 16): drift transitions, eval_failed, budget 80/90%, model_deprecated
Spend appears on BOTH on purpose; both read the SAME runs.cost_usd figure the quota engine uses

items: services/runtime/obs.py · tables runs · spans · trace_id → Langfuse
